name: skewbench-final
purpose: Confirmatory single-model single-layer study. Resolve every UNSET field and freeze against the pilot before starting final runs.

environment.hardware: 2 x NVIDIA H100 94 GB, same node, NV6 interconnect
environment.input_source: Seeded Gaussian hidden states with controlled synthetic logical routes

analysis.aggregate_weighting: equal declared trace_variant/batch cells, then equal independent seeds
analysis.selection_rule: Pilot informs final configuration only. Score B5 cooldowns using pilot_selection; freeze one cooldown and every other parameter before final runs with disjoint seeds.

pilot_selection.scope: Tune only B5 cooldown on pilot seeds. These are parameter candidates for one baseline, not additional final methods.
pilot_selection.ranking_data: All seven pilot case variants, both batch sizes, both pilot seeds; no final-seed observations.
pilot_selection.eligibility: All paired B5/B3 GPU runs must complete correctly. A candidate is stable-eligible when the geometric mean paired B5/B3 stationary runtime ratio is at most 1.02 at each batch size.
pilot_selection.objective: Among stable-eligible candidates minimize the equal-cell, equal-seed geometric mean paired B5/B3 runtime ratio across all seven case variants and both batch sizes.
pilot_selection.tie_rule: Treat candidates within 1% of the best all-case ratio as tied; choose the largest cooldown among that set to reduce unnecessary churn.
pilot_selection.fallback: If no candidate satisfies the stationary pilot constraint, minimize the worst per-batch stationary B5/B3 ratio; among candidates within1% of that score, minimize the all-case ratio; among within1% ties choose the largest cooldown. Report that the pilot constraint was not met.
pilot_selection.freeze_rule: Record all three pilot scores and the selected cooldown, then freeze exactly one B5 value before final runs. Pilot scores are selection evidence only, not confirmatory confidence intervals.

diagnostics.coordinate_system: measured zero-based steps; add32 for raw trace coordinates
